data.name: TipExternalConsole
data.value: Launch Claude Code in a separate console window instead of the docked terminal. Unlike the docked tab, it survives closing Visual Studio.

data.name: TipAutoAccept
data.value: Apply edits without opening the diff (and launch new sessions in acceptEdits). Resets when VS restarts.

data.name: TipAutoAcceptLocked
data.value: Edits are pre-approved by the CLI session (permission mode '{0}'). Change it in the terminal (shift+tab), or start a new session.

data.name: TipAllowDrive
data.value: Let Claude continue/step and set breakpoints while paused. Resets when VS restarts.

data.name: TipAllowCapture
data.value: Let Claude capture the debugged app's window, a window by title (e.g. your browser), or the screen as image attachments. Every capture is logged and staged as a visible chip. Resets when VS restarts.

data.name: TipNotify
data.value: Show a notification bar (and flash the taskbar when VS is in the background) when Claude finishes responding or needs your input.

data.name: BannerHooksOnlyTitle
data.value: ⚠ A Claude session is running, but not connected to Visual Studio

data.name: BannerHooksOnlyText
data.value: Its hooks are reaching this workspace's bridge (token stats update), but the session was launched outside the extension and never connected the IDE channel - so edits won't open the review diff and selection isn't shared. Run /ide in that Claude terminal and pick Visual Studio (works from any folder inside the workspace), or relaunch from here. The vs-debug / vs-semantic tools additionally need the session started at the workspace root.

data.name: BannerConfigTitle
data.value: ⚠ Workspace hooks & tools didn't load for this session

data.name: BannerConfigText
data.value: Claude connected, but this session never loaded the workspace's .claude configuration - so the edit-review diff, notifications, and the vs-debug / vs-semantic / test tools are all inactive. Usually Claude was started outside (or in a subfolder of) the workspace{0}, so its project directory doesn't include our hooks - or the project MCP servers weren't approved. Relaunch from here (pins the right folder), or start claude at the workspace root; approve the vs-debug / vs-semantic servers if prompted.

data.name: TipPaste
data.value: Paste from the clipboard: a screenshot (Win+Shift+S), copied files, or copied text (opens in the composer to review/edit, then attaches as .txt). Ctrl+V in the panel works too.

data.name: TipCompose
data.value: Write multi-line text in an editor (line breaks, code, whatever), then attach it as a .txt with an @ reference in the Claude composer.

data.name: ChipNeedsTool
data.value: Not a format Claude reads directly - it will use a script/tool on it.

data.name: ChipStagedRetry
data.value: Staged - sends when Claude connects. Click to retry.

data.name: ComposePrompt
data.value: Edit freely - line breaks, trimming, whatever you need. Attach stages this as a .txt and drops an @ reference into the Claude composer. (Ctrl+Enter attaches.)

data.name: ReasonPrompt
data.value: Tell Claude what to change about {0} (optional):

data.name: MarqueeNoticeText
data.value: New: the panel now lists every change Claude makes, so you can click straight to the line it edited. Claude can also build your solution with Visual Studio's own build and read the Output window, including the exceptions your app swallows.

data.name: TipRunWildOn
data.value: Run wild is on: edits now apply without the diff. Tip: press Shift+Tab in the Claude terminal to switch the session itself to auto-accept (covers non-edit prompts too).

data.name: EditsTooltipRewritten
data.value: {0} Too much changed to list line by line. Click to open the file.
